location: first table, row "PT Indonesia Tsingshan Stainless Steel furnace explosion ... Morowali", note "The claim is the industrial park's initial count."
what_was_checked: Accuracy of the note against the source
finding: The 18 deaths were not the initial count. The Jakarta Post article (27 Dec 2023) gives 18 from the industrial park's spokesperson and says "the police also revised the death toll up from 13 to 18"; Free Malaysia Today (26 Dec) has the toll "risen to 18 as of Tuesday from 13 on Sunday". The first count on the day of the explosion was 13 (some reports 12). The police article giving 21 is from 4 Jan 2024. So the two figures differ by when they were counted, not because one was a first count. The row's period label "both 2023-12-24 to 2023-12-24" also hides that the counts were made on different days. The same words "IMIP initial count" are in the figure's detail in the figures table.
evidence: Figure m-9c8c94a6a5 (detail "worker deaths in PT ITSS furnace explosion, IMIP initial count"). Suggested note: "The claim is the industrial park's count of 26 December 2023, as the Jakarta Post reported it; the police figure was published on 4 January 2024." Correct the figure's detail to match.
